task: Make the Scheduler page project and resource filters true multi-select by preserving full arrays through SchedulerFilters, SchedulersQuery store params and URL sync, against the already-shipped backend that accepts repeated query params.

key_reasoning.reason: Three components across two layers in one product area: SchedulerFilters (handleApply, areFiltersEmpty, definitions), SchedulersPage (URL read/write), schedulersStore (SchedulersQuery, fetchSchedulers params). api.ts, ProjectSelector and Filters already handle arrays and are untouched.

Base risk S: closest pattern is getFiltersFromUrl in src/utils/filters.ts (getAll) plus api.ts default 'separate' array serialization, and the backend contract is backward compatible. Bumped to M because the AC enumerate variant cases (uncheck one of several, clear all -> unfiltered, resource filter parity) and no existing test covers multi-select, empty-array semantics, store param serialization or page URL round-trip; the refreshOnValuesUpdate loop means every hop must preserve arrays.

About 3 source files plus 2-3 test files (rewrite scalar assertions in SchedulerFilters.test.tsx, add store params and/or page URL-sync coverage), 0-1 new, across src/pages/schedulers and src/store. Calibration: bundled S example (epmcdme-10102, total 11) is a comparable narrow two-layer change; this sits slightly higher due to test surface, consistent with S.
